g.text: A four-cell interaction escapes every fixed-height band
Blue cells differ from the alternating background; dashed lines enclose the original four rows.
The two marked extreme cells lie at (y, x) = (3 − t, t) and (t, 3 − t) for every t ≥ 4.
Local induction proves continued escape. The growing wake is not an isolated traveling object.
